notes: Cross-verse split on supplied object pronouns. Nine other verses in this chapter fold a supplied English object pronoun onto the verb that requires it, including 27:31 and 27:43 where a coreferential Greek accusative is expressed and separately realized. This verse alone kept all three English *him*s on the single αὐτόν as one discontinuous unit. Distributed to match: αὐτόν keeps the *him* it governs in *they bound him*, and the repeated *him*s are rule 7 helpers on the finite verbs that require them.
